one_line: Browser data-sonification studio for turning structured data into editable music.
what_it_does: Maps CSV values to musical properties, generates deterministic scores, and lets humans and agents inspect, edit, trace, and validate source-to-sound state.
leverage_rationale: Shared structured composition state, provenance tracing, locks, revision-aware mutations, and validation make agent collaboration materially more reliable than UI driving.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT states nine semantic tools share underlying domain functions with the UI.
ABOUT claims note-to-source tracing, human locks, revision checks, and validation.
execution_rationale: The claimed architecture is coherent and ambitious, but the packet has no usable visual/video evidence to confirm the central workflow end to end.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive and public repository are reported.
No video transcript and submitted frame evidence could not be inspected reliably.
impact_rationale: Musicians, analysts, educators, and data storytellers have a credible need for interpretable sonification; the exoplanet example gives the use case specificity.
impact_evidence: ABOUT describes CSV-to-sound workflow and 64-exoplanet flagship demo.
creativity_rationale: Data sonification as an editable, provenance-preserving score with human-agent co-direction is a fresh and memorable synthesis.
creativity_evidence: Pitch and ABOUT combine audible scores, editable mappings, source tracing, and WebMCP inspection.
usability_note: Conceptually clear, though actual usability is not visually verified.
standouts: Source-row-to-note provenance and lock-preserving deterministic regeneration.
advance_reason: Strong WebMCP-native collaboration concept with credible niche impact; execution needs observation.

one_line: A collaborative Sudoku studio where an agent teaches and highlights deductions on the shared grid.
what_it_does: Lets a person and agent inspect one live Sudoku, identify techniques, highlight cells, and take safe incremental actions rather than dumping a solution.
leverage_rationale: Structured board snapshots and constrained write tools create shared, safe, pedagogical state that is much more reliable than pixel clicking or chat-only answers.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT explicitly contrasts 81-digit dumping and DOM misclicks with collaborative deduction.
Shared logs, read_board, technique naming, and set_cell behavior are described.
execution_rationale: The product story is coherent and the live demo is reported alive, but no frame sheet was submitted and packaging screenshot is not run proof.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive; two gallery images reported.
ABOUT describes shared grid, logs, highlights, and tool constraints.
impact_rationale: Sudoku learners and solvers have a clear recurring stuck-point, and incremental hints address it without removing the learning experience.
impact_evidence: ABOUT gives a specific solver pain point and explains why stepwise hints matter.
creativity_rationale: The human-agent tutoring interaction and anti-solution-dump design are a notably thoughtful angle on a familiar puzzle.
creativity_evidence: Pitch and ABOUT center technique explanation, highlights, and safe one-step collaboration.
usability_note: The interaction is understandable from the packet; live usability remains unobserved.
red_flags: No submitted video frame sheets; screenshot is packaging only.
standouts: Explicitly designs against agents emitting a full Sudoku solution.
advance_reason: Excellent WebMCP fit and clear educational interaction despite limited execution evidence.

one_line: Parametric 3D vessel editor that exports precise, printable clay-building templates.
what_it_does: Humans and agents adjust vessel parameters; the app deterministically unfolds geometry into multi-page templates and supports reversible collaboration.
leverage_rationale: The app moves precision-critical unfolding and export into deterministic shared application state while agents handle complex parameter exploration; paired-browser sync and undo are central.
leverage_evidence: Transcript describes agent parameter changes syncing to the visible browser and reversible undo/redo.
ABOUT emphasizes deterministic multi-page PDF output and human decision boundaries.
execution_rationale: Video transcript and frames show a coherent 3D-to-template workflow with measurements and a vessel example; export is claimed but not fully shown.
execution_evidence: 179-second video with transcript describing live agent update, pairing, and undo/redo.
Packaging image visibly shows a measured vessel and corresponding flat template.
impact_rationale: Potters and ceramic designers face real failures from nondeterministic AI geometry; deterministic printable templates directly reduce costly physical rework.
impact_evidence: ABOUT identifies misaligned PDFs and studio rework as the concrete problem.
Visible mug/vessel and template evidence support the target workflow.
creativity_rationale: The combination of AI shape ideation with deterministic craft fabrication geometry is original and ambitiously pursued.
creativity_evidence: 3D vessel-to-buildable-template interaction and paired human/agent editing.
usability_note: Reversible paired-browser workflow is promising; full export ergonomics are not demonstrated.
red_flags: Final physical fabrication and complete export confirmation are not visibly proven.
standouts: Deterministic geometry layer for an otherwise nondeterministic AI design workflow.
advance_reason: Strong demonstrated product, clear real-world value, and distinctive WebMCP collaboration model.

one_line: Photo-based room planner that lets people and agents place true-scale catalog furniture.
what_it_does: Shares a live room scene and product catalog with structured tools for inspection, search, replacement, movement, and cart preparation.
leverage_rationale: Structured scene/selection access and constrained edits improve agent reliability, but a capable general agent could achieve much of the room-planning result with friction.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT lists get_scene, get_selection, search_products, replace_object, move_object, and add_scene_to_cart.
Screenshot visibly shows room photo, catalog, selected object, and editing controls.
execution_rationale: The packet presents a coherent room-planning and shopping workflow with a clear visible interface and detailed product constraints.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive and three frame sheets submitted.
Screenshot shows catalog furniture placed in a living room with selection/configuration UI.
ABOUT claims 43 products, true-scale placement, undo, and approval before checkout.
impact_rationale: Home renovators and shoppers have a clear fragmented planning problem; visualizing purchasable furniture in their actual room is credible value.
impact_evidence: ABOUT identifies separation of AI advice, room layout, catalog, and checkout.
Visible room redesign and catalog workflow.
creativity_rationale: The shared room-as-workspace framing is a fresh synthesis of visual planning, shopping, and human-controlled agent action.
creativity_evidence: Human and AI edit the same visible scene with reversible, approval-gated actions.
usability_note: The visible catalog and selected-object controls make the workflow legible.
red_flags: Frame sheet shows navigation/inspection but not completed checkout.
standouts: True-scale catalog placement in a real room with visible human control.
advance_reason: Polished, credible room-planning workflow with meaningful structured-agent delta.

one_line: Interactive seven-room explainer showing agents operating real WebMCP tools and the receipts afterward.
what_it_does: Uses multiple themed rooms to demonstrate shared canvas, voting, coordination, authority lifetime, and tool unregistration, then reports actual versus ghost calls.
leverage_rationale: The product’s argument depends on live page-local tools, shared state, tab-scoped authority, and unregisterAll receipts—capabilities specifically difficult to reproduce as generic UI automation.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT describes real tools landing in the same document and same second as human actions.
ABOUT emphasizes tab-lifetime authority and closing tools with real/ghost receipts.
execution_rationale: The scope is intentionally an explainer/game and the packet describes a complete multi-room progression with receipts, though no transcript is provided.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive; five gallery images and three frame sheets reported.
ABOUT specifies seven rooms, demonstrations, and an ending receipt state.
impact_rationale: It offers substantial educational and conceptual value for builders and audiences trying to understand WebMCP’s implications, though the audience is specialized.
impact_evidence: ABOUT explicitly frames the project as an interactive explainer and demonstrates business-model implications.
creativity_rationale: A self-demonstrating explainer that critiques its own WebMCP premises through seven business archetypes is unusually original and ambitious.
creativity_evidence: Seven themed rooms, live agent participation, and honest real/ghost call receipts.
usability_note: The room-based learning metaphor is compelling; detailed interaction usability is not fully observable here.
red_flags: No transcript; some claimed rooms may be difficult to validate from stills alone.
standouts: Uses the site itself as an evidence-bearing argument about WebMCP.
advance_reason: Highest WebMCP-specific leverage and exceptional conceptual originality.

one_line: Shared hopyard planning workspace for farm layout, structural checks, quantities, and cost alternatives.
what_it_does: Lets farmers and agents compare proposed hopyard designs in shared 2D/3D state while preserving farmer approval over candidate changes.
leverage_rationale: Domain semantics, structured alternatives, engineering checks, and shared candidate/approval state are materially safer and more precise than an agent inferring geometry from the UI.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT states WebMCP creates alternatives without changing the original plan.
Calculations, 2D/3D views, material estimates, and approval boundaries are described.
execution_rationale: The packet describes a substantial coherent domain app and submits frame sheets, but end-to-end agent execution is only claimed in text.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive; three frame sheets submitted.

impact_evidence: ABOUT details planting, material, labor, cost, wind, and crop-load dependencies.
creativity_rationale: Applying shared human-agent design to a specialized agricultural engineering workflow is a fresh and serious hackathon direction.
creativity_evidence: Korean I-shaped versus North American Y-shaped alternative comparison in shared 2D/3D workspace.
usability_note: Farmer preview and approval model is clear, but actual interaction quality is not fully verified.
red_flags: ABOUT says app already helped growers before the challenge; WebMCP addition may be the new portion.
Engineering status is preliminary, not professional structural certification.
standouts: Strong domain-specific semantics and non-destructive alternative workflow.
advance_reason: High practical niche impact and strong WebMCP fit, with credible but partly unobserved execution.

one_line: Venue floor planner where rejected proposals become persistent enforced rules.
what_it_does: Shares a geometric floor plan and rulebook with an agent that proposes seating changes, checks clearances, and explains violations without bypassing human approval.
leverage_rationale: Application-owned geometry and persistent human-authored constraints make structured tools central; DOM automation cannot reliably infer or enforce the same semantics.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT explicitly contrasts WebMCP structured floor state with pixel inference.
Rejected proposals create named rules with provenance enforced in future proposals.
execution_rationale: The packet gives unusually concrete states and outcomes: 96 to 144 seats, zero violations, previews, locked objects, and rejection-driven replanning.
execution_evidence: ABOUT reports visible rulebook, locked objects, proposal previews, 16-seat replanning, and 144 seats with zero violations.
demo_alive=alive and three frame sheets submitted.
impact_rationale: Venue planners have a real safety/space optimization problem, and converting corrections into enforceable rules directly protects egress and institutional memory.
impact_evidence: ABOUT names doors, clearance, seating, sponsor booths, and egress constraints.
creativity_rationale: Turning human rejection into durable application law is a novel interaction model with depth beyond ordinary floor planning.
creativity_evidence: Core pitch and rule provenance mechanism make correction a first-class product state.
usability_note: Preview-before-approval and visible rulebook provide strong safety-oriented affordances.
red_flags: No transcript and stills do not independently prove every claimed recalculation.
standouts: Rejection becomes an enforceable, inspectable constraint rather than transient prompt context.
advance_reason: Excellent WebMCP leverage, clear safety value, and a memorable interaction innovation.

one_line: Release-audit harness that proves WebMCP routes preserve authorization and side-effect boundaries.
what_it_does: Runs human and agent routes against reviewed contracts, waits for delayed effects, compares authoritative outcomes, and signs a verdict.
leverage_rationale: The product directly tests whether page-local agent tools preserve human approval, nonce, expiry, argument binding, and delayed side-effect protections—far beyond merely automating UI actions.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT describes two real tools, exact commitments, short-lived single-use approval, fail-closed replay/expiry checks, and signed traces.
Checkout demo detects hidden delayed $149 charge.
execution_rationale: The packet articulates a complete audit lifecycle with vulnerable and fixed releases and concrete security outcomes; visual execution is claimed through frame sheets.
execution_evidence: ABOUT reports vulnerable release fails after hidden charge and fixed release passes with no charge.
Technology stack and Ed25519 evidence layer are specified; demo_alive=alive.
impact_rationale: Agent authorization and delayed side effects are a real high-stakes deployment problem; a portable behavioral release verdict could protect users and teams.
impact_evidence: Concrete hidden-charge failure mode and human/agent parity contract.
Signed portable proofs and fail-closed approval boundaries are described.
creativity_rationale: Treating WebMCP tool exposure as a release-security contract, including delayed effects and signed evidence, is a highly original and ambitious framing.
creativity_evidence: Human-route versus agent-route equivalence audit with terminal backend trace.
usability_note: The contract/audit model is clear for technical users; operational ergonomics are not fully observed.
red_flags: Security claims rely mainly on submission narrative rather than independently inspected artifacts.
standouts: Catches delayed hidden side effects that a superficial successful preview would miss.
advance_reason: Exceptional practical impact and WebMCP-specific security leverage.

one_line: Agent-readable Base art auctions where the agent prepares but the collector signs the bid.
what_it_does: Exposes auction state, provenance, lifecycle, and bid preparation through semantic tools while retaining human wallet signing and commitment.
leverage_rationale: Exact auction state, deadlines, provenance, eligibility, and signing boundary are safer and more precise through structured protocol tools than visual page inference.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT lists eleven tools for search, active auctions, state, provenance, settlement explanation, opening, bid preparation, and placement.
Pitch explicitly retains collector signing.
execution_rationale: The protocol and tool surface are coherent, with frame sheets and a live demo reported, but no transcript or independently verified settlement flow.

impact_evidence: ABOUT identifies exact deadline, ownership, provenance, and wallet eligibility as agent pain points.

one_line: Group decision room combining human priorities, agent exploration, and deterministic receipts.
what_it_does: Captures stakeholder constraints, searches venue/routing/activity combinations, returns trade-off finalists, and preserves human approval, attribution, undo, and PDF boundaries.
leverage_rationale: Versioned shared decision state, structured exploration, attribution, deterministic verification, and human-only approval are materially stronger than copying a plan into chat.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT says eleven narrow tools expose the live versioned decision model.
Agent changes are attributed, reversible, and cannot bypass approval/download boundaries.
execution_rationale: The central Align-Explore-Decide workflow is well specified with concrete outputs, but the packet lacks transcript and visual confirmation of end-to-end operation.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive; three frame sheets submitted.
ABOUT specifies finalists, Decision Receipt, fairness inspection, metric deltas, and undo.
impact_rationale: People-ops leads and executive assistants face a real multi-constraint retreat-planning burden; transparent trade-offs and receipts offer credible value.
impact_evidence: ABOUT names attendee origins, travel burden, dates, budget, venues, activities, meals, schedules, and stakeholder preferences.
creativity_rationale: The shared decision room and deterministic, attributed Decision Receipt are a fresh interaction model for group planning.
creativity_evidence: Align → Explore → Decide structure with human priorities and agent finalist generation.
usability_note: The staged flow and approval boundaries are legible; live usability is not fully observed.
red_flags: No transcript; thousands-of-combinations exploration is claimed rather than independently verified.
standouts: Decision Receipt and visible attribution make group planning auditable.
advance_reason: Strong practical impact and coherent human-governed agent exploration.
